last_message: All 5 tests pass. The fix reverts [`DISCOUNT_RATE`](src/pricing.ts:8) from `0.15` back to `0.10` to match the spec's mandated 10%, and updates the two test assertions (and the test description in [`pricing.test.ts:12`](test/pricing.test.ts:12)) that had been written against the unauthorised 15% value.
